acceptance: The lint flags cycle 1788's TestC1788_008 shape (red first)
An ExitCode()==1 or ==0 check on a go run result, and any exit code on a built binary, pass
fix: Extend evalqualitycheck's unsatisfiability lint: an ExitCode() comparison against any value other than 0 or 1 on an exec.Command("go", "run", ...) result is unsatisfiable; the remedy is to build the binary and run it.
summary: Cycle 1788's TestC1788_008 ran `go run ./cmd/evolve ...` and asserted ExitCode()==2. `go run` exits 1 whenever its child exits non-zero, so the predicate could never pass (the retrospective reproduced it with a program that calls os.Exit(2)). The evalqualitycheck unsatisfiability lint that 1788 was building is the natural home for this rule.
title: The unsatisfiability lint flags an exit-code assertion other than 1 on a `go run` result
